name: Cash box at home
blurb: Safe from swings, but it never grows. Prices rise every year, so the same notes buy a little less each time.

name: Banyan Savings
blurb: Slow and steady, like the Pillalamarri banyan dropping new roots: growth that makes more growth. Made up for this game; assumes about 8% a year, and real returns vary.

name: Chai Stall Fund
blurb: Some years the stall is packed, some years it's quiet. Can grow more than Banyan, but it swings. Made up for this game; assumes about 10% a year, and real returns vary and can be negative.

name: Mango Orchard Co.
blurb: A great harvest can pay big. A bad monsoon can wipe out a year. Big swings both ways. Made up for this game; assumes about 14% a year, and real returns vary and can be very negative.
